item.title: Privacy Auditing for ML Models and LLMs
item.description:
Overview

Developing practical frameworks for evaluating privacy risks in deployed ML systems — moving from abstract concerns to concrete evaluation and mitigation workflows. Part of DFKI’s MissionKI project.

Research Focus

Membership Inference Attacks

Assessing whether models leak information about their training data — critical for healthcare, financial, and other sensitive domains.

Model Inversion Risk Analysis

Evaluating the risk of reconstructing sensitive training data from model outputs or gradients.

Domain-Specific LLM Auditing

Fine-tuning and auditing LLMs in specialized domains (healthcare AI) with privacy compliance requirements under the EU AI Act.

Technical Approach

  • Automated evaluation pipelines for privacy metrics
  • Risk scoring and threshold-based alerting
  • Integration with model lifecycle management
  • Compliance documentation workflows for regulatory requirements

Impact

Supporting trustworthy AI deployment in high-stakes domains where privacy guarantees are not optional.
